item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 20/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and it will be warm during the day over Guangdong in the next couple of days. A relatively humid easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. It will be cloudier with light rain over the region. A trough of low pressure will affect southern China in the latter part of next week.
